check_domain.description: Check whether a domain belongs to a disposable (throwaway) mail service and whether it can receive mail, without a full address. Use it to screen a company's website or an email's domain.
check_domain.name: check_domain

parameters.description: The domain to check, such as mailinator.com. A link or an email address works too.
parameters.name: domain

disposable.description: Whether it belongs to a disposable (throwaway) mail service

disposable_score.description: How strong the evidence of a disposable address is, from 0 to 100

dns_inconclusive.description: True when the mail server lookup timed out, so a missing mail server is not certain; check again later

free_provider.description: Whether it is free webmail, such as Gmail or Yahoo

has_mail_server.description: Whether the domain has mail servers to receive mail

is_subdomain.description: Whether the domain is a subdomain of another

is_valid.description: True when the syntax is valid, the domain can receive mail and it is not disposable

mail_servers.description: The domain's mail server (MX) host names

parent_domain.description: The parent domain, for a subdomain

signals.description: Disify's evidence codes, such as blacklist_exact or no_mx_records

top_level_domain.description: The domain's ending, such as com

trusted_provider.description: Whether Disify lists the domain as a trusted provider

verdict.description: One word for the result: valid, invalid_format, disposable, no_mail_server or dns_inconclusive

check_email.description: Check whether an email address is real and usable: valid syntax, a domain that can receive mail, and not a disposable (throwaway) address. Also says whether it is free webmail or a role address such as info@, and suggests a fix for a misspelled domain.
check_email.name: check_email

parameters.description: The address to check, such as jane@example.com.
parameters.name: email
